about_bio:
Behind every flawless set of nails is a vision — and that vision belongs to Tiana, the founder and creative force behind **Nail Lovers by Tiana**. With years of hands-on experience and an obsessive eye for detail, Tiana has built a reputation as one of Lagos' most sought-after nail and lash technicians.

From bold stiletto acrylics to delicate French tips and stunning lash extensions, Tiana approaches every client as a canvas. Her work blends technique with artistry — always pushing creative boundaries while maintaining the highest standard of quality and hygiene.
